# Style and conventions {#sec-style}

This page describes the rules that are followed by the code. The rules are
checked by two tools, `flake8` and `pydocstyle`, which are run with `make lint`.

## The layout of the project {.unnumbered}

```
main.py                     Entry point for Qollab.
qollab_api.py               The functions that Qollab pages call (they return text).
requirements.txt            Dependencies for Qollab.
pyproject.toml              Local development and packaging.
Makefile                    The build and the convenience targets.
make/                       The makefiles that the Makefile includes.
  Makefile.git              The branch workflow.
  Makefile.quarto           The build of this book.
.flake8                     The style rules of flake8.
.github/workflows/ci.yml    The continuous integration (lint and tests).
backend/                    The library.
  __init__.py               The public API: compile, export, __version__.
  core/
    model.py                The frozen dataclasses of the pipeline.
    errors.py               The exception hierarchy.
    constants.py            The fixed mathematical constants (never changed).
    config.py               The tunable configuration parameters.
    to_qiskit.py            The bridge from a native circuit to a Qiskit circuit.
    provider/               Provider detection and noise profiles.
    compiler/               The pipeline orchestration.
    transpiler/             Transpilation for the backend.
    translator/             Translation into the native gate set.
    simulator/              The statevector, the gate matrices and the tomography.
    vectorizer/             The Bloch vectors.
    sampler/                The simulated measurement of a step.
    metrics/                The didactic metrics.
    formatter/              The JSON contract.
    exporter/               The JSON serialization.
tests/                      The pytest suite.
examples/                   Worked circuits (for example the QFT adder).
scripts/                    The demo scripts and the generator of the files of out/.
frontend/                   The viewers (index.html, viewer3d.html, viewer.html).
shaders/                    The volumetric shaders of the spheres.
documentation/              The specification, the schema and this book.
  _quarto.yml               The configuration of this book.
  index.qmd                 The preface.
  docs/                     The chapters of this book.
  diagrams/                 The PlantUML diagrams and their SVG renders.
  schema/                   The JSON schema of the contract.
```

## One module per package {.unnumbered}

Each pipeline stage lives in its own package:
`backend/core/<module>/<module>.py`. The public function has the same name as the
module, and it is a verb.

| Module | Function |
| --- | --- |
| `transpiler` | `transpile` |
| `translator` | `translate_circuit`, `translate_native_ops` (and `Translator.translate`) |
| `simulator` | `simulate` |
| `vectorizer` | `vectorize` |
| `metrics` | `measure` |
| `formatter` | `format` |
| `exporter` | `export` |
| `sampler` | `sample` |
| `provider` | `detect` |
| `compiler` | `compile` |

## Imports {.unnumbered}

Imports are absolute, from the root of the package.

```python
from backend.core.transpiler import transpiler   # correct
from core.transpiler import transpiler            # incorrect
```

The second form does not work in Qollab, because the project root is the first
entry of `sys.path` there.

## Purity {.unnumbered}

The public functions are pure. An object is received, and a new object is
returned. The input is never changed. There is no global state.

A frozen dataclass is used for every object that travels between the stages, so
that an accidental change raises an error.

## No printing inside the library {.unnumbered}

The `print` function is used only in `scripts/` and in `main.py`. Inside
`backend/core`, the `logging` module is used instead.

```python
import logging

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
logger.warning("a useful message")
```

## Comments and docstrings {.unnumbered}

- The code is written in English. The identifiers, the comments and the
  docstrings are in English.
- Every module, every public class and every public function has a docstring.
- A docstring starts with a short line in the imperative mood, for example
  "Return the ...". The line ends with a full stop. A longer description follows
  after a blank line when it is needed.
- The units of every parameter and of every return value are stated.

## Type hints {.unnumbered}

Type hints are given in every public signature. The `from __future__ import
annotations` line is used at the top of a module, so that the newer syntax works
on older interpreters.

## Line length and formatting {.unnumbered}

- The maximum line length is 88 characters.
- The rules `E203` and `W503` are ignored, because they conflict with common
  formatting tools.
- The settings are stored in `.flake8`. The rule `E501` is ignored for `main.py`
  only, because Qollab needs the whole signature of `main` on one line to build
  its form.

## The memory of the project {.unnumbered}

The chat of an agent is emptied between sessions, but the repository is not. The
file `memory.md` in the root is the hand-over: the current state, what was
decided, what is pending, and how to continue. `CLAUDE.md` imports it, and
`AGENTS.md` asks every agent to read it at the start and to update it at the end
of each change. `make resume` shows the branch, the last commits, the changes that
are not pushed and the pending list. The file is kept short (a test checks that it
stays under 150 lines), and the design stays in `spec.md`, which wins when the two
disagree.

## Git {.unnumbered}

- `main` is the stable branch. `development` is the integration branch.
- One branch is used per module: `feature/<module>`.
- A commit is made only when the team asks for it.
- A commit message is written in English. The first line is a short summary, and
  a body with bullets is added when it helps.
